title: Juniper and the Confession
author: Juniper Thornbury
blurb: Ivo Okafor, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
